result.reason: The clause implements the Customer affiliate/M&A carve-out, a reasonableness standard for consent, and protection against termination, suspension, or repricing following Customer change of control. However, it omits the required absolute prohibition on Garman assigning to a Sparkling competitor. It also unnecessarily adds Section 20(d) as an exception to the restrictions on transferring, leasing, exporting, or sublicensing the Work, potentially expanding rights beyond assignment of the Agreement and altering unrelated commercial intent. The cross-reference should instead address only assignment of the Agreement.
